title: T3 — Candidate solutions
body:
# T3 — Candidate solutions

## Candidates

1. A new PM engine with its own state machine.
2. The spine primitives composed by a PM job (chosen).
3. A procedure-driven PM run over the bus.

## Criteria

Dual control must be structural; the record must be the same rows every other surface reads; the
approach must not fork the action registry; a baseline change must be a first-class change row.

## Options rejected

Candidate 1 duplicates the approval and baseline primitives and would fork the record. Candidate 3
makes the PM's gates depend on a run's completion; the gates must hold outside any run. Candidate 2
composes `charter`, `projects.baseline`, `changes.request`, `close_request` and `close`, which are
the programme's own primitives.
